Editor lip flap._note: Fallback only: three mouth shapes swapped in the editor. Dialogue shots use Wan 2.2 14B by default.

Kling 4._note: Paid fallback for hero shots if the free test fails. Change a shot's model to this in shots.csv.

budget._note: Money caps. The free plan spends nothing; raise these only if you route shots to Kling 4.

kaggle._note: username: your Kaggle username. weekly_gpu_hours stays under Kaggle's ~30 h so a stuck run cannot use it all. max_queue_hours: when a second GPU backend is connected, a batch still waiting for a Kaggle GPU after this long is handed to it.
kaggle._stages_note: Only these stages run on Kaggle. refs and keyframes are off: on 26 Nov, with the decoder in fp32, all 24 stills still went NaN at step 1 inside the transformer (fp16; T4s have no bf16). Qwen-Image needs an Ampere-or-newer GPU.

video_weights._note: Real-ESRGAN anime-video model (BSD-3): built for frame-to-frame stability, so takes do not flicker.

image_weights._note: Real-CUGAN 3x (MIT) for stills. Community re-upload of the official weights; swap in your own copy if you prefer.

refs.negative_prompt: photorealistic photo, live action, flat sketch, text, watermark, logo, signature, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, lowres
refs._note: Qwen-Image-2512, Apache 2.0, 50 steps with CFG for quality. The first GGUF in `prefer` that fits the GPU is used (A100 40 GB: Q8_0; L4: Q6_K). Needs bf16: Ampere or newer, or Apple Silicon (mac backend).

fal._note: Paid fallback only. Endpoint ids are NOT verified; check each before a paid run.

refs._note: Gate 1: reference stills painted on Kaggle from style_bible/ref_prompts.json when style_bible/refs/ lacks them.

mac._note: Your own Apple Silicon Mac renders stills and keyframes for free with mflux (docs/mac-worker.md). Set for a 32 GB Mac: 4-bit models with --low-ram. With 48 GB or more, use mac.engines_8bit instead (better quality).

colab._note: Google Colab pay-as-you-go: bf16 GPUs for stills and keyframes (docs/colab.md). The producer sizes each batch to what is left of total_cap_units (the owner's agreed budget: 100 units = $9.99); the runner will not start a VM below min_balance_units. Rates are units per GPU-hour as Colab charged them in 2026.
colab._gpus_note: bf16 GPUs only (T4 makes Qwen go NaN). G4 = RTX Pro 6000; its rate is unconfirmed, 6.0 is a conservative guess until the runner measures it. H100 is not offered to this account.
